_comment: OPS17 Mission Control v1 config. NO SECRETS IN THIS FILE. The DB password comes from %APPDATA%\postgresql\pgpass.conf via psql -w, exactly as the ops rail already does. Host/port/user/db are already public in CLAUDE.md and are connection coordinates, not credentials.

terminal._comment: OPS20: `exe` and `command` are resolved to absolute paths at server STARTUP (via where.exe) instead of being left to whatever PATH the child inherits — that PATH gap is what made the button report a false 'opened'. newWindowArgs pins `-w new` so these sessions get their own window even if windowingBehavior is later set to reuse one; it was not the cause of the original bug.

backups._comment: OPS25: backup-age panel. Tier 3 is read from the filesystem (a stat, no credentials). Tier 2 is read from the GitHub Actions run history via the `gh` CLI, which carries its own auth — the board never touches the service-role key and never lists the bucket. warnDays/alertDays are chosen for a WEEKLY cadence: 8 days means one run was missed, 14 means two. Both tiers failed silently for 11 weeks before this panel existed.

focus._comment: OPS22: after a confirmed spawn, hand the new window's pid to focus-window.ps1 so it comes to the FRONT of the browser you clicked in. Windows' foreground lock blocks a background process from taking focus, so the activator walks a ladder and reports which rung won. enabled:false reverts to the old behaviour (window opens behind). flashFallback:false suppresses the taskbar-flash cue when no rung can take focus — leave it true, it is the only signal left at that point.
